diff --git a/django/utils/autoreload.py b/django/utils/autoreload.py
index 7ca0d68fae..3fb561f1be 100644
--- a/django/utils/autoreload.py
+++ b/django/utils/autoreload.py
@@ -114,7 +114,15 @@ def iter_modules_and_files(modules, extra_files):
         # During debugging (with PyDev) the 'typing.io' and 'typing.re' objects
         # are added to sys.modules, however they are types not modules and so
         # cause issues here.
-        if not isinstance(module, ModuleType) or getattr(module, '__spec__', None) is None:
+        if not isinstance(module, ModuleType):
+            continue
+        if getattr(module, '__spec__', None) is None:
+            # __main__ (manage.py) has __spec__ set to None in some cases
+            # (e.g. PEP 451). Fall back to __file__ for modules without
+            # __spec__.
+            filename = getattr(module, '__file__', None)
+            if filename is not None:
+                sys_file_paths.append(filename)
             continue
         spec = module.__spec__
         # Modules could be loaded from places without a concrete location. If
